document.about: Three invented lines printed to PDF by headless Chrome on macOS (fixtures/chrome-text-layer.html): Helvetica as CID TrueType, PingFang SC as Type 3 fonts, each with ToUnicode. Wide forms, the micro sign, a fraction and trade marks; a CJK ideograph whose glyph the font's ToUnicode names as a radical, with the ideograph stated in /ActualText; zero-width spaces before a word.

notes: Reprint with: Chrome --headless --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf=chrome-text-layer.pdf chrome-text-layer.html, then update the sha256.
The zero-width-space split was fixed by the out-of-turn space rule (insee-stray-spaces) before this case was written; it is checked here on the shape it was reported on.
